title: When AI Speaks, Whose Values Does It Express? A Cross-Cultural Audit of Individualism–Collectivism Bias in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper conducts a cross-cultural audit using personal and moral dilemmas (such as arranged marriage, filial duty, and 'Religion vs. career') to measure cultural value systems and normative advice in LLMs, which directly involves ethics, morality, and religious values.
